name: Joseph Smith Sr.
role: Father of Joseph Smith and first patriarch of the Church
dateNote: He was baptized on 6 April 1830, the day the Church was organized, and ordained patriarch on 6 December 1834.
importance: Section 4 was given for him in February 1829, when he visited his son at Harmony. He was one of the Eight Witnesses, and section 23 calls him to exhort and strengthen the Church. In Kirtland he sat on the first high council in 1834 and became the Church’s patriarch. Section 90 lets him keep his home, and section 124 says after his death that he “sitteth with Abraham”.
connections: Husband of Lucy Mack Smith and father of Alvin, Hyrum, Joseph, Samuel, William, Don Carlos, and others. In section 137 Joseph reports seeing his father and mother in the celestial kingdom, while both were still living.

sources.title: Joseph Smith Sr., Joseph Smith Papers

reviewNote: Birth, death (14 September 1840, Nauvoo), baptism, patriarch ordination, and Eight Witnesses checked on the JSP page. Sections 4, 23, and 137 refer to him without the full name; only “Joseph Smith, Sen.” (90, 102, 124) is used as a link form, since bare “Joseph” is ambiguous.
